falseSynonyms.zh: section 是更廣、更靈活的文本分段；一個 chapter 可以包含多個 sections。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Chapter 3 contains four sections. Read the next section carefully.

falseSynonyms.zh: part 是最廣義的『部分』，不一定是正式文本層級；chapter 通常是有明確結構的一章。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON This part of the report is difficult. The book has twelve chapters.

falseSynonyms.zh: volume 是一冊／卷，通常比 chapter 大；一個 volume 可以包含很多 chapters。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The series has three volumes. Each volume contains ten chapters.

falseSynonyms.zh: page 是一頁，層級遠小於 chapter；兩者不能互換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Turn to page 45. Read Chapter 4.

falseSynonyms.zh: unit 主要是教學／課程結構；普通小說 chapter 不一定是 learning unit。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Unit 5 includes a quiz. Chapter 5 introduces a new character.

falseSynonyms.zh: phase 只適合 chapter 的比喻義，表示人生／事業／計劃的階段；不能替代實體書籍章節。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Retirement began a new phase of life. The book's final chapter is short.

falseSynonyms.zh: episode 只適合事件性／敘事性比喻義，或電視節目中的一集；不是一般書籍 chapter。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The scandal was a brief episode in his career. The novel has twenty chapters.

falseSynonyms.zh: branch 只適合協會／組織的地方分支；書籍中的 chapter 不能改成 branch。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The charity opened a new branch. I read the final chapter.
